parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, primarily made of glass with a thin plastic or metal frame. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and graphical user interfaces. It is the primary output component of the display.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed to the base and does not move independently, though the entire display may tilt slightly depending on the stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum for stability and support. It connects the screen to the surface it rests on.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen, maintaining balance and allowing for possible tilt adjustments. It ensures the display remains upright and stable.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself is stationary, but it may allow the screen to pivot or tilt slightly depending on the hinge mechanism.
